entities.summary: Johannes Antonius de Kok, O.F.M. is a Dutch Roman Catholic prelate, who served as Auxiliary Bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Utrecht from 1982 until his retirement in 2005. A member of the Order of Friars Minor (Franciscans), he combined pastoral ministry with service in diocesan governance for more than two decades.
